## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Asaṅkamanapaṭisandahanapañha* ("The Question on Rebirth and Transmigration", Mil 3.5.5) is a dialogue situated in the third division of the *Milindapañha*. The text deals with the nature of rebirth without the transmigration of a permanent entity. An English translation of the discourse has been produced by John Kelly.

A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese translation of the *Milindapañha* tradition at T 1670b 2.48, addressing rebirth.
